name: hardware-install
title: Hardware installation guide
domain: Physical device installation: safety, unpacking, mounting, cabling, power-on, indicator lights, specifications. Dense with numbers, units and ranges.
seedNotes: corpuskit import --seed 20261021; inject passes in this order: heading_skip only (seed 20261023, density 0.03), utilize only (seed 20261024, density 0.02), every other kind except exclaim (seed 20261021, density 0.16), exclaim only (seed 20261022, density 0.02). One kind per pass keeps a kind that matches almost every sentence from crowding out the rest. The same seeds on the same sources give the same project.

licence.note: The whole project folder is an adaptation of CC BY-SA 4.0 material and is published under the same licence. Never mixed into code.

authors: Source text: Raspberry Pi Ltd and contributors (see NOTICE.md)
howMade: **Seeded violations (origin `seeded`, status `proposed`, by `generator`).** `corpuskit inject` inserted each defect and wrote an exact span label from the final DOM, so the span is right by construction. The injector's catalog is the CorpusKit default with the appended sentences rewritten for a device guide and a `unit_space` kind added (`_prep/hw-defects.yaml`); the shared `corpus/schema/defects.yaml` has no operations, so it cannot be passed to `inject --defects`. The generator's rule hints were mapped to the rule ids the engine and `corpus/DigitalBanking` use (for example `structure:alt-text` to `structure:AltText`, `company:plain-language` to `company:plain-language/*`). `heading_skip` labels cover the whole heading and carry no quote, as in DigitalBanking, because the quote would span a variable value that `FlareAI.Scoring validate` does not resolve. They stay `proposed` until the two-labeller pass confirms the sentence still reads naturally.

**Natural violations (origin `natural`, status `verified`, by `dom-check`).** A fact of the markup, no judgment: an `img` with no alt text (`structure:AltText`) and a table with no header cell (`structure:TableHeader`). The source figures that have a title got it as alt text during conversion; the rest have none.

**Natural exempt labels (verified, `dom-check`).** Text inside `code` (pin names, file names, commands) and every `pre` block are `exempt` for `lint`: a prose rule matches the text but it is written exactly as the product shows it.

**Natural clean and exempt labels (status `proposed`, by `generator`).** Device labels and model variants (`STATUS`, `JIG ETH`, `10-inch`) are `clean` for any rule; values with units in table cells (`Around 25 × 24 mm`, `3 g`, `2.4 GHz`) are `clean` for `google:units-of-measure/*` and `google:numbers/*`; the `Related topic:` label and the print-notice sentence, repeated in every topic, are `exempt` for `lint`. These are rule-based readings and need the hand-read or two-labeller confirmation before they count.
density: Seeded violations are about 6% of the 2,069 blocks that carry text (good prose, as the design asks), spread over the kinds listed above. The text comes from a maintained product guide, so it already contains the usual natural problems; those are not labelled yet (see below).
Units are written with a space in the source. The `unit_space` kind removes that space in a seeded sample (millimetres, gigahertz, megahertz, gigabytes, volts, grams, watts).
pending: The blind two-labeller pass over every block (design 1.4 steps 2-3) has not run: `tools/FlareAI.Labeler` does not exist yet (work package 12). So natural violations in the prose (passive voice, `will`, `e.g.` and so on) are not labelled, no block is marked `block-complete`, and none of the 70% `block-complete` target is met. Do not read a missing label in this project as proof that the text is clean.
Seeded labels are `proposed`, not `verified`: the LLM check that the sentence still reads naturally (design 1.4 step 3) is part of that pass.

The project has not been opened in Flare 22 or built to HTML5 and PDF by hand; `corpuskit check` passes (every file parses, every xref, snippet, image, variable and condition resolves, every label anchors once).

Quoted text: the source has no quotation blocks, so this project has no quote labels. The images carry the source product's marks; only the surrounding text, alt text and file names were made fictional.
rebuild:
```powershell
# source: git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/raspberrypi/documentation (commit in project.json)
# _prep holds the converter and the steps; paths inside are the ones used on the build machine
python -I _prep/adoc2html.py _prep/hw-curated.json   # AsciiDoc to HTML topics, names made fictional
uv run --with pillow python _prep/shrink_images.py <out>/images
.\scripts\make-corpus-v2.ps1 ...   # import, scaffold, then _prep/enrich_hw.py, inject x2, contexts, _prep/natural_labels.py, contexts --update, check
.\tools\FlareAI.Scoring\bin\Release\net48\FlareAI.Scoring.exe validate --labels corpus\v2\hardware-install\labels.jsonl --kinds corpus\schema\defects.yaml --root corpus\v2\hardware-install
```
`_prep/build-hw.ps1` runs the whole chain in order.
